h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturers & Suppliers in Sasaram

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturers & Suppliers in Sasaram

items.pText: Sasaram, home to the tomb of Sher Shah Suri, is a district town in the hot plains of south-western Bihar. Schools are the main buyers of playground equipment here, from small private schools to larger campuses that want a proper play area. FunPlay Systems makes this equipment at our factory in Vasai East, Maharashtra, about 1,300 km away, and sends it by road.

Most school managements in Sasaram start by asking what a playground will cost. The honest answer is that it depends on a few choices you control, which we explain below. Send us the size of your ground, the classes that will use it and some photos. We reply with suggested equipment, a layout drawing with the safe play area marked and a quote you can compare.

props.h2Text: How would you like to start?
props.pText: Turn your playground dreams to reality

richText.heading: What decides the cost of a school playground

c: Four things move the budget most. First is the number and size of the pieces, since one large structure costs more than a swing and a slide. Next comes the surface, because rubber flooring adds cost but cushions falls and stays usable after rain. Third is the footing: grouted posts need concrete work, while some pieces can stand on a firm base. Last is site preparation, such as levelling and drainage, which your contractor may handle.
A sensible plan is a few
now and a larger structure later. Summers in Sasaram are fierce, so leave budget for shade. See our page for nearby

facts.label: Delivery and installation

items.q: Can you suggest equipment within a fixed school budget?
items.a: Yes. Tell us your budget along with the ground size and age group. We will suggest pieces that fit both and show them on a layout drawing before you decide.

items.q: Is rubber flooring needed for a school in Sasaram?
items.a: We recommend an impact-absorbing surface under swings, slides and climbers. Rubber flooring cushions falls and dries faster than soil after the monsoon, which matters on a busy school ground.

items.q: Do you also supply outdoor gym equipment in Sasaram?
items.a: Yes. Our Fun Fitness range suits staff, older students and parks. You can add a few machines at the edge of the same ground and include them in one layout.
